03-15-1006 is March 15, 1006.  
24 weeks = 168 days. Plus 1 day = 169 days earlier.  
March 15 minus 169 days:  
1006 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not 400, so not leap).  
Days in Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 15 → Jan+Feb = 59 days, so Mar 15 is day 74 of year.  
74 - 169 = -95 days from start of year, so go to previous year 1005 (not leap).  
365 - 95 = 270th day of 1005.  
270th day: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → sum through Aug = 243 days, plus 27 into September → September 27.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-09-27
